<?xml version='1.0' encoding='UTF-8'?>
<xsl:stylesheet xmlns="reference-data:2" xmlns:xsl="http://www.w3.org/1999/XSL/Transform" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:stroom="stroom" version="3.0" xpath-default-namespace="records:2" exclude-result-prefixes="stroom">
  <xsl:template match="records">
    <referenceData version="2.0.1" xsi:schemaLocation="reference-data:2 file://reference-data-v2.0.1.xsd">
      <xsl:apply-templates select="record"/>
    </referenceData>
  </xsl:template>
  <xsl:template match="*">
    <!-- left out: disabled accounts -->
    <xsl:if test="not((data[@name='status']/@value = 'disabled'))">
      <xsl:if test="normalize-space(data[@name='user']/@value)">
        <reference>
          <map>USERS</map>
          <key>
            <xsl:value-of select="data[@name='user']/@value"/>
          </key>
          <value>
            <xsl:value-of select="data[@name='name']/@value"/>
          </value>
        </reference>
      </xsl:if>
    </xsl:if>
  </xsl:template>
</xsl:stylesheet>
